note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Research could NOT be completed: the web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt, DuckDuckGo lite/html endpoints timed out, Google returned HTTP 429, and Bing ignored quoted phrases and returned only irrelevant 'Metro by T-Mobile / LA Metro / Metro.co.uk' results. Therefore sanctions exposure (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), Indian court cases (party role/status), regulator actions, credit rating and Russia/CIS supply evidence are all reported as null = NOT VERIFIED, not as 'clean'. Do not read null as absence of risk. Only verified item: the company's own website (https://www.metrotyres.com/ and /exports, fetched today) describes Metro Tyres as a Ludhiana/Punjab-origin tyre maker (7 plants, 'USD 140 million conglomerate', 'Star Export House'), with export markets listed as Middle East, Latin America, Africa, Asia, Mexico, Brazil, Nigeria, Chile, Zambia, Argentina, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Europe/America. Russia and the CIS are NOT mentioned anywhere on the site's export page — this is a self-declaration of markets, not evidence of any shipment, and absence of Russia from a marketing page is not proof of no Russia trade. No customs, bill-of-lading, court or sanctions record was retrieved. Recommended: re-run this company once search connectivity is restored, checking OFAC SDN/EU/UK consolidated lists, BIS Entity List, eCourts/NCLT/CCI, and Indian trade press for Russia/CIS tyre exports.
